firstPlayerRule: Whoever was most recently in a laboratory receives the starting-player token and chooses an order space first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The other players choose order spaces clockwise. Those spaces determine play order for the rest of the round; the token holder is not necessarily first to perform an action.
Players declare actions from the lowest order space upward, then resolve actions from the highest space downward.
